nodes.description: Private owner address; gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress privileges.
Public mapping of token balances mutated by transferFrom, _mints and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested allowance mapping read/written by transferFrom and approve.
Whitelist mapping bypassing the sale condition checks in ensure.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Address that bypasses the ensure() restrictions, writable by owner only.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and as the transfer origin.
Public payable transfer() that forwards directly to transferFrom using msg.sender.
Public payable transferFrom performing unchecked allowance/balance updates and calling ensure().
Internal view gate that grants bypass for owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale, otherwise calls condition().
Internal view sale-limit checker reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata.
Low-level DELEGATECALL to a user-controlled address, executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
Privileged mint/whitelist function callable by owner or a hardcoded address; sets balances and canSale.
Owner-only loop distributing tokens using unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress bypass slot.
Public approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation via keccak256 of token ordering and init code hash.
Unchecked subtraction of _value from allowance[_from][msg.sender] and balanceOf[_from] plus unchecked addition to balanceOf[_to].
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length and unchecked balance decrement/increments in the distribution loop.
Owner-only initialization of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale limits.
Constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender, initial balance and infinite UNI allowance.
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn performs a low-level call with decoded return data, an external call surface.
Source address of the transferFrom call.
Destination address of the transferFrom call.
Amount moved in transferFrom, subtracted and added without SafeMath.
Target contract address for the delegatecall in delegate().
Calldata bytes forwarded to the delegatecall in delegate().
Account whitelisted and credited by _mints.
Raw amount assigned as balanceOf[spender] in _mints.
Array of recipient addresses iterated by batchSend.
Per-recipient amount multiplied by the array length in batchSend.
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed with unchecked arithmetic.
Locally computed Uniswap pair address used as a bypass condition in ensure().

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to _from and used as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing balances.
init requires msg.sender == owner to set sale limits.
Constructor stores msg.sender as the contract owner.
approve writes allowance indexed by msg.sender.
transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) as an authorization gate.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic on _value.
transferFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] and increments balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
_from parameter flows into the balance, allowance and ensure checks of transferFrom.
_to parameter is the recipient credited in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives all arithmetic in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from allowance and balances without overflow protection.
ensure falls back to condition(_from, _value) when no bypass matches.
ensure grants a bypass when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure grants a bypass when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure grants a bypass when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address used in the bypass check.
Local _UNI computed in ensure is compared against _from.
_UNI is the return value produced by pairFor inside ensure.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale cap.
delegate forwards parameter a as the delegatecall target.
delegate forwards parameter b as the delegatecall calldata.
delegate executes a delegatecall that transfers control to arbitrary external code.
User-supplied address a determines the code executed by the delegatecall.
User-supplied bytes b determine the calldata of the delegatecall.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting the account past ensure().
_mints writes balanceOf[spender] directly from addedValue.
spender parameter is the account credited and whitelisted by _mints.
addedValue parameter becomes the raw balance set by _mints.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for the caller and each recipient without SafeMath.
batchSend computes total and modifies balances with unchecked arithmetic.
_tos array is iterated to distribute tokens in batchSend.
_value is the per-recipient amount distributed by batchSend.
Local total is produced by the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress bypass slot.
approve writes _value into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
init sets _saleNum which condition() uses for the sale cap.
Constructor assigns owner, establishing the privileged role.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
Constructor sets an infinite allowance for the UNI router address.
SafeERC20 performs low-level external calls whose return data is decoded, another external control transfer surface.
